title: Listen to the Rustling Sacred Oaks
desc: Quiet your breath and attempt to interpret the whispering leaves of Zeus' ancient oak.

transcript.speaker: Prophecy
transcript.text: Beneath the murmur of bronze cauldrons, the rustling foliage forms an ancient dactylic hexameter: 'Trust the aegis when the earth rumbles.'

addJournalKnowledge.title: The Whisper of Dodona
addJournalKnowledge.text: The sacred oak foretold of trusting the divine aegis during seismic tremors.

transcript.speaker: Narrator
transcript.text: The leaves whisper softly, but their meaning is lost in the gusting mountain wind.
